lines.beaver: 요즘 얼굴이 안 좋아 보여. 무슨 일 있어?
lines.beaver_en: You look tired lately. What's going on?
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum eolguri an joa boyeo. Museun il isseo?
lines.learner: 응, 회사 일 때문에 골치가 좀 아파.
lines.en: Yeah, work is giving me a headache.
lines.roman: Eung, hoesa il ttaemune golchiga jom apa.

lines.beaver_en: What happened? Tell me about it.
lines.learner: 새 프로젝트를 맡았는데 부담감이 너무 커.
lines.en: I took on a new project, and the pressure is huge.
lines.roman: Sae peurojekteureul matanneunde budamgami neomu keo.

lines.beaver_en: Everyone must expect a lot from you.
lines.learner: 맞아. 그 기대감 때문에 불안감도 생겼어.
lines.en: Right. Those expectations made me anxious too.
lines.roman: Maja. Geu gidaegam ttaemune burangamdo saenggyeosseo.

lines.beaver: 그 마음, 계속 참고만 있었던 거야?
lines.beaver_en: Have you just been holding it all in?
lines.beaver_roman: Geu maeum, gyesok chamgoman isseotdeon geoya?
lines.learner: 응, 감정을 억누르다 보니 더 막막해.
lines.en: Yeah, suppressing my feelings makes it feel more hopeless.
lines.roman: Eung, gamjeongeul eongnureuda boni deo mangmakae.

lines.beaver_en: Do you ever feel alone on your team?
lines.en: Yeah, I feel left out on my team these days.

lines.beaver_en: Do you ever compare yourself to coworkers?
lines.learner: 응, 솔직히 열등감도 좀 있어. 인정할게.
lines.en: Yes, honestly I feel a bit inferior. I admit it.
lines.roman: Eung, soljjiki yeoldeunggamdo jom isseo. Injeonghalge.

lines.beaver_en: Then do you feel like quitting?
lines.learner: 포기할까도 했는데, 잘하고 싶은 마음이 더 커.
lines.en: I thought about giving up, but I want to do well more.
lines.roman: Pogihalkkado haenneunde, jalhago sipeun maeumi deo keo.

lines.beaver: 쉬는 날에도 일 생각만 하는 거 아니야?
lines.beaver_en: Aren't you thinking about work even on days off?
lines.beaver_roman: Swineun naredo il saenggangman haneun geo aniya?
lines.learner: 맞아. 쉬지 못해서 가족한테 죄책감도 들어.
lines.en: Right. I can't rest, so I feel guilty toward my family.
lines.roman: Maja. Swiji motaeseo gajokante joechaekgamdo deureo.

lines.beaver_en: So what do you want to do from here?
lines.learner: 지금 나한테 필요한 건 안정감임에 틀림없어.
lines.en: What I need now must be a sense of stability.
lines.roman: Jigeum nahante piryohan geon anjeonggamime teullimeopseo.

lines.beaver_en: I'm glad you're so sure. I'm rooting for you.
lines.learner: 고마워. 이런 대화는 큰 위로임에 틀림없어.
lines.en: Thanks. Talks like this must be a big comfort.
lines.roman: Gomawo. Ireon daehwaneun keun wiroime teullimeopseo.
